rebol-278.detail: Rebol 2.7.8 interpreter (Red's documented toolchain). Official Linux artifacts are 32-bit x86 only; host is x86_64 with no 32-bit userspace; all official binary-transfer channels are egress-blocked; no faithful provisioning channel exists in-sandbox.

tasks.title: Red lexer/compiler baseline (Rebol tooling bootstrap)
tasks.description: Establish the Red lexer/compiler test baseline by running the existing Rebol-hosted Quick-Test harness against lexer.r, UNCHANGED. No lexer rule is implemented unless a defect is first traced to the governing specification.
tasks.scope: Tooling bootstrap: run tests/source/compiler/lexer-test.r under Rebol 2.7.8 with lexer.r unmodified.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: lexer-test.r exits 0 under Rebol 2.7.8 with lexer.r unchanged

declared_blockers.detail: Host x86_64 has no 32-bit execution capability (no /lib/ld-linux.so.2, no libc6-i386, no qemu-user/binfmt)
All official binary-transfer channels egress-blocked; no faithful channel carries an approved 32-bit R2 artifact
No grant to install host 32-bit compatibility or to substitute the toolchain

tasks.title: libRed C integration
tasks.description: Build and integrate the libRed C library against the Red runtime (libRedRT), per the libRed architecture and C API reference. Requires a working Red build (Rebol-driven).
tasks.scope: libRed/ build + C API integration; depends on a compiled Red runtime (libRedRT).

validation_commands.purpose: Build libRed via the Red toolchain

acceptance_criteria.criterion: libRed builds and links against libRedRT produced by the Red toolchain

tasks.title: Runtime /hash behavior
tasks.description: Define and validate the normative behavior of the Red runtime /hash refinement. Currently the specification is incomplete (normative hash algorithm/seeds are undefined); additionally the runtime compile path is Rebol-driven.
tasks.scope: runtime/crypto.reds + runtime/natives.reds /hash refinement; requires a normative specification AND the Rebol-driven Red runtime compile.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: /hash behavior is normatively specified and the runtime test exits 0

spec_gaps: HASH-GAP-1: normative hash algorithm and seed(s) for the /hash refinement are undefined

tasks.scope: RFC-0075 CFCKEP runtime implementation; specification must be reconciled first.
